quotes.text: Por atender a hijos/as enfermos/as o cuidarles. .............. 5
Por atender a otras personas dependientes del hogar..... 6
No tiene tiempo por su trabajo doméstico, el cuidado de niños/as u otras personas dependientes.......................... 5

assessments.reasoning: The supplied questionnaires mention care activities only as reasons for not working during the reference week (f.6), reasons for not working more hours (f.63), or reasons for not seeking work (f.71). Per indicator instructions, care given as a reason for not working or for not working more hours does not count. The instrument does not contain any question asking whether a person supervises or remains available to care for household members while doing other activities.
